standard_prerequisites.name: A projective module becomes free after adding a free module
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the free module containing F plus P.

core_obligations: By the projective-plus-free-is-free lemma there is a (possibly infinite) free module F with F + P free (proof lines 39017-39019). Since F + P is free, the element (0, s) lies in some finite free direct summand K of F + P (proof lines 39019-39021). Any finite subset of a free module lies in a finite free direct summand F' of F, so K is contained in F' + P with F' finite free, giving the required finite free direct summand of F + P containing (0, s) (proof lines 39021-39022).
proof_roadmap: Add a free summand to make F + P free (proof lines 39017-39019).
Cut out a finite free direct summand containing (0, s) (proof lines 39019-39022).
